charts.title: cellcell-compete-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 20-tick competition run: two CPM cells (colored by cell id) sharing one glucose field, seeded with parity but diverging fast as the higher-glucose_vmax competitor (id 1) claims an ever-larger share of the shared lattice while the lower-vmax competitor (id 2) is pushed toward a vestigial fragment of its starting footprint. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_colony_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same 20-tick run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: cellcell-crossfeed-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 20-tick cross-feeding run: a glucose-to-acetate secretor (id 1, seeded inside the localized glucose depot) and an acetate-consuming cell (id 2, seeded outside it) sharing one glucose+acetate field pair. The consumer's footprint never touches the glucose depot but is visibly reached by the secretor's expanding acetate plume as the run progresses. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_colony_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same 20-tick run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: cellcell-crossfeed-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly per-cell time-series panel of the same 20-tick cross-feeding run, synced to the GIF's time axis: biomass, volume, local_glucose, and local_acetate for both the secretor (id 1) and the consumer (id 2). The consumer's local_glucose stays flat at 0.0 the entire run while its local_acetate and biomass both rise, back-loaded to the last several ticks once the plume arrives -- the cross-feeding handoff made directly visible. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.metrics_panel` over the same run as the GIF, for provenance. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick, per-cell values.
